content: Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ kɑ̃ bɑ n kiɑnu yĩirumɔ kɑ kilo ye yɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee, ɑdɑmɑ u kĩwɑ bɑ n yĩirumɔ kɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee.
Tii suɑbu bu rɑ kɑ ɡɛndu nɛwɑ. Be bɑ tii kɑwe berɑ bɑ bwisi mɔ.
Gemɡiin ɡem kobu bu rɑ nùn kpɑrewɑ win wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u ǹ nɑɑnɛ mɔ, u rɑ ɡbiwɑ win weesun sɔ̃.
Dukiɑ kun kpɛ̃ yu tɔnu wɔrɑ Gusunɔn siribun sɑnɑm, ɑdɑmɑ ɡem mu rɑ tɔnu wɔre ɡɔɔn di.
Gemɡiin dɛɛrɑru tɑ rɑ dewɑ win swɛɛ yi n wɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ kɔ̃ɔrewɑ win nuku kɔ̃surun sɔ̃.
Gemɡiin dɛɛrɑru tɑ rɑ nùn kɑri ɡbɑrewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son tiin binɛ yɑ rɑ nùn yinɑ mwɛwɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ ɡbiwɑ kɑ win yĩiyɔbu sɑnnu. Yĩiyɔ bi u rɑɑ doke win dukiɑ sɔɔ, kpɑ bu kɑm ko.
Gemɡii u rɑ yɑriwɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun di, kpɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u kɔsire ko ni sɔɔ.
Wi u Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru sikimɔ, u win winsim kpeerɑsiɑmɔwɑ kɑ win ɡɑri, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ rɑ yɑriwɑ min di ben yɛ̃run sɔ̃.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɡemɡibɑ kuurɑmɔ, wuuɡibu bɑ rɑ n nuku dobu mɔwɑ. Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ̀ n mɑɑ biru wurɑ, bɑ rɑ n yɛ̃ɛrimɔwɑ.
Gemɡibɑ bɑ rɑ de wuu ɡu kuurɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ rɑ ɡu ɡowɑ kɑ ben ɡɑri.
Wi u win winsim ɡɛmɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ, u rɑ mɑriwɑ.
Wi u rɑ tɔnun kɔ̃sɑ sɑɑri, u ku rɑ tɔmbun ɑsiri bere, ɑdɑmɑ nɑɑnɛɡii u rɑ ye berewɑ win tii sɔɔ.
Tɔn be bɑ ǹ kpɑro mɔ bɑ rɑ kɑm kowɑ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ bwisi kɛ̃ɔ dɑbiru mɔ beyɑ bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Wi u nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ u nɛɛ, u koo win winsim dibu kɔsiɑ, u koo wɑhɑlɑ wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u yinɑ u nɔɔ mwɛɛru ko, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Kurɔ ɡeowɑ u rɑ siɑrɑbu wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ, dukiɑ tɔnɑwɑ bɑ rɑ wɑ.
Tɔn ɡeo, ɡeɑ ye u mɔ̀, wi sɔɔrɑ yɑ rɑ wure. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ tɔn kɔ̃so, kɔ̃sɑ ye u mɔ̀, wi sɔɔrɑ yɑ rɑ wure.
Tɔn kɔ̃son sɔmburun ɑre kun ɑrufɑɑni mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u ɡem swĩi, ɑre ɡeeyɑ u rɑ n mɔ.
Wi u wurɑ u ɡem swĩi, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɔ̃sɑ nɑɑ ɡire u koo ɡbiwɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u tɔn kɔ̃sobu tusɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bèn sɑnu sɑnusu dɛɛre, berɑ u rɑ kɑ nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛri.
Bɑ koo tɔn kɔ̃sobu sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ kɑm kɑm, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ sere kɑ ben bibun bweserɔ.
Kurɔ burɔ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kurusɔ ɡe bɑ wurɑn tɑɑbu dokeye wɛ̃rɔ.
Geɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ n kɑsu u ko, ɑdɑmɑ ye tɔn kɔ̃so u kĩ kpuro, Gusunɔn mɔruwɑ yɑ rɑ seeye.
Wi u rɑ wɛ̃ kɑ nuku tiɑ, wiyɑ u rɑ ko ɑrumɑniɡii. Wi u ku rɑ mɛnɑm kɑ̃, u rɑ tii sɑ̃ɑru kpɛ̃ɛwɑ.
Nuku tiɑɡii u koo dukiɑ wɑ n kpɑ̃. Wi u win winsim nim kɑ̃, bɑ koo mɑɑ yɛ̃ro nim kɛ̃.
Wi u rɑ win dĩɑnu bere ɑre bɛkɛn sɔ̃, wiyɑ bɑ rɑ bɔ̃rusi, ɑdɑmɑ wi u dɔrɑmɔ, wiyɑ bɑ rɑ domɑru kue.
Wi u ɡeɑ mɔ̀, u koo Gusunɔn domɑru wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u bwisikumɔ u kɔ̃sɑ ko, kɔ̃sɑ yɑ koo yɛ̃ro deemɑ.
Wi u win nɑɑnɛ doke dukiɑ sɔɔ, u koo wɔrumɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibɑ koo kpɑrɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u kɑ win yɛnu wɑhɑlɑ nɑɑwɑ, u koo kɑm nɑɑ ɡirɑ. Gɑri bɔkɔ u ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwisiɡiin yoo.
Gem kobu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑ̃ɑrun nuuru. Bwisiɡii, bwisiyɑ u rɑ kɑ tii tɔmbu ɡɑwe.
Gemɡii u rɑ win ɑre wɑwɑ tɑrɑ mi. Kɑɑ sere ɡere tɔn kɔ̃so?
